ownership.quote: The startup was co-founded in 2021 by Burkay Gur, a former Coinbase machine learning leader and Oracle engineer, and Gorkem Yurtseven, who was previously a developer at Amazon.

stage.quote: The new round is coming less than three months after Fal announced a $125 million Series C at a $1.5 billion valuation led by Meritech.
stage.note: TechCrunch (Oct 2025) reports fal 'closed a new round' of ~$250M at a >$4B valuation led by Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia, but does not name the round's series letter (likely Series D); labeled here as series-c because that is the last round TechCrunch explicitly named as a stage. If the >$4B round is confirmed as a priced Series D, stage would be series-d+.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of confirmed TechCrunch-reported rounds: $9M seed + $14M Series A (2024) + $125M Series C (Jul 2025) + ~$250M unnamed round (Oct 2025, TechCrunch citing 4 sources); PitchBook separately estimated ~$200M raised prior to the Oct 2025 round per TechCrunch.
total_funding_usd.quote: Fal previously raised nearly $200 million, according to PitchBook data.

last_round.quote: Fal.ai, a startup that hosts image, video, and audio AI models for developers, has closed a new round valuing the company at over $4 billion, four people familiar with the deal said. The company raised approximately $250 million, two of the people said.

revenue.basis: TechCrunch citing First Round Capital partner Todd Jackson's LinkedIn post at the time of the Series C announcement
revenue.quote: At that time, the company's revenue crossed $95 million and its platform was used by over 2 million developers, Todd Jackson, a partner at First Round Capital, wrote on LinkedIn.

note: Sep 2024 TechCrunch article reported Fal's annual run rate at nearly $10M (~$800k/month) and a 17-person staff, with the Series A valuing the company at $80M; by Jul 2025 ARR reportedly reached ~$95M at a $1.5B valuation (Series C, led by Meritech), and by Oct 2025 the company reportedly raised ~$250M more at a >$4B valuation led by Kleiner Perkins/Sequoia (fal itself did not comment). Not a YC company (ycombinator.com/companies/fal returns 404); no accelerator/incubator affiliation found. Co-founded 2021 by Burkay Gur and Gorkem Yurtseven.
